summary: David Dubie, 43, of Lakewood crashed off Boulder Canyon Road into a cove just west of Barker Dam around 11:30 p.m.; the red vehicle was found upside down, half submerged with ice frozen around it, about six feet offshore; Dubie exited the car, walked disoriented across the frozen reservoir toward lights on the southeast shore, and collapsed partway up the hill toward Alpine Drive; his body was found by an Alpine Drive resident the next morning
location: Barker Reservoir, cove just west of Barker Dam, Nederland
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Sugarloaf Fire Protection District; Boulder Emergency Squad divers; Nederland Police Department; Colorado DOT; Colorado State Patrol
notes: Crash ~11:30 p.m. Wednesday (surveillance camera); body found Thursday 2015-12-17; autopsy pending (hypothermia vs crash injuries); alcohol/drugs possible factors per CSP
